name: rea
summaryEn: General reverse-engineering server for native binaries, Electron/JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies, APKs and websites, returning findings with evidence.
summaryKo: 실행 파일, Electron 앱, .NET, APK를 한 서버로 역분석하고 근거까지 돌려줘요.
capabilities: pseudocode and assembly of native code via Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna
static analysis of JavaScript and Electron apps (no extra engine)
guideEn: Run the stdio server with 'npx -y rea-agents@6.9.0 mcp' (the repo's mcp.json pins this version). Give tools the absolute path of the target; findings come with evidence and limits. Static JavaScript analysis works with no extra tools; native code needs a separately installed engine such as Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna. Node 22.23.4+ (or 24.22.1+ / 26.12.1+) is required.
guideKo: 'npx -y rea-agents@6.9.0 mcp'로 stdio 서버를 띄워요(저장소 mcp.json과 같은 버전 고정). 분석할 대상은 절대 경로로 주고, 결과에는 근거와 한계가 함께 와요. 자바스크립트 정적 분석은 추가 도구가 필요 없고, 네이티브 코드는 Hopper, Ghidra, IDA, Kuna 같은 엔진을 따로 설치해야 해요. Node 22.23.4 이상이 필요해요.
warningsEn: Native analysis needs a separately installed Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna (some are paid); Encela does not install them.
Project disclaimer: not for DRM or license-check circumvention, cheats, or bypassing access controls.
Large package; the first npx run downloads it. Pin the exact name rea-agents: look-alike repositories exist.
warningsKo: Node 22.23.4 이상이 필요해요.
네이티브 분석은 Hopper, Ghidra, IDA, Kuna를 따로 설치해야 하고 일부는 유료예요. Encela가 설치해 주지 않아요.
DRM·라이선스 우회, 게임 치트, 접근 통제 우회는 프로젝트가 지원하지 않아요.
용량이 커서 처음 npx 실행 때 내려받는 시간이 걸려요. 비슷한 이름의 저장소가 있으니 패키지 이름 rea-agents를 정확히 쓰세요.
runEvidence: Repo mcp.json: {"command":"npx","args":["-y","rea-agents@6.9.0","mcp"]}; npm registry rea-agents 6.9.0, license MIT, bin {rea, rea-agents}, engines node ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1; package.json license MIT.
concerns: Telemetry grep: only test/diagnostic code hits (send_beacon test fixtures, HopperDiagnostics), no outbound analytics seen. The repo has a licenses/ folder with third-party texts (GPL, LGPL, etc.) for reference; project license is MIT and optional engines are not bundled in the npm files list. Very new and fast-moving.
reason: MIT, committed today, npx start with a pinned version, works without extra tools for JavaScript.
problems: Popularity claim (LinkedIn stars) is unverified; set to unknown.
Removed the 'setup' step claim from guide (not needed for catalog).
checked: Read LICENSE, mcp.json, package.json, npm registry bin/engines, README start lines, telemetry grep.

name: radare2
summaryEn: MCP server on top of radare2 for disassembly, analysis and function listing, with a read-only mode.
capabilities: SQL queries over analysis (with r2xsql plugin)
guideEn: Install with 'r2pm -Uci r2mcp'; the client config runs 'r2pm -r r2mcp' over stdio. Call open_file first, then analyze, then use the other tools. Read-only mode (-R) and the sandbox lock limit what the agent can do; avoid yolo mode, which disables approvals and exposes dangerous run tools.
guideKo: 'r2pm -Uci r2mcp'로 설치하고 클라이언트에서는 'r2pm -r r2mcp'를 stdio로 실행해요. open_file로 파일을 연 뒤 analyze하고 나머지 도구를 써요. 읽기 전용(-R)과 샌드박스로 권한을 줄일 수 있고, 승인을 끄는 yolo 모드는 쓰지 않는 게 좋아요.
warningsEn: Needs radare2 and r2pm on PATH (the README badge shows radare2 6.2.4).
Installing through r2pm builds C code and needs a compiler toolchain.
Keep read-only mode on unless you want changes; yolo mode disables approvals.
warningsKo: radare2와 r2pm이 PATH에 있어야 해요(README 배지는 radare2 6.2.4).
r2pm으로 설치하면 C 코드를 빌드하므로 컴파일러가 필요해요.
변경을 막으려면 읽기 전용을 켜 두고, 승인을 끄는 yolo 모드는 피하세요.
runEvidence: README: '$ r2pm -Uci r2mcp', '$ r2pm -r r2mcp', config {"command":"r2pm","args":["-r","r2mcp"]}; 'Supports readonly mode, sandbox lock and restrict tools'; 'r2mcp yolo on|off disables approvals'.
concerns: Telemetry grep found nothing. radare2 itself is LGPL but installed by the user, not bundled. No npm/PyPI package; start depends on r2pm. Proposer's '6.1.2 or later' version claim not found in README; replaced.
reason: Official radareorg project, MIT, recent commits, read-only and sandbox switches.
problems: Version requirement '6.1.2+' not in README; corrected to the badge value 6.2.4 as informational.
checked: Read LICENSE, README install and config sections, tool/yolo/readonly lines, telemetry grep, ls-remote.

name: pyghidra-mcp
licenseQuote: Apache License, Version 2.0, January 2004 (LICENSE; no filled-in copyright line)
summaryEn: Headless Ghidra MCP server (no GUI needed) that imports binaries into a project and decompiles, searches and cross-references them.
summaryKo: Ghidra를 화면 없이 돌려 여러 바이너리를 디컴파일하고 검색해요.
capabilities: import binaries or folders into a Ghidra project
guideEn: Start with import_binary, then list the project binaries. Use the symbol, string and code search tools to find targets, decompile_function to read them, and list_xrefs / gen_callgraph to follow code. GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR must point at a Ghidra install. The README recommends streamable-http, with stdio (the default transport) as a local fallback; add '--project-path <dir>' to keep the project between runs.
guideKo: import_binary로 파일을 가져온 뒤 프로젝트의 바이너리 목록을 확인해요. 심볼, 문자열, 코드 검색 도구로 대상을 찾고 decompile_function으로 읽고 list_xrefs, gen_callgraph로 따라가요. GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR이 Ghidra 설치 폴더를 가리켜야 해요. README는 streamable-http를 권장하고 stdio(기본값)는 로컬용이에요. --project-path를 주면 프로젝트가 유지돼요.
warningsEn: Needs a Ghidra install (set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR) and a matching JDK.
First analysis of a large binary can take minutes and a lot of memory.
Edit tools can change names and types inside the Ghidra project.
warningsKo: Ghidra 설치(GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR)와 맞는 JDK가 필요해요.
큰 바이너리는 첫 분석에 시간과 메모리가 많이 들어요.
편집 도구는 Ghidra 프로젝트 안의 이름과 타입을 바꿀 수 있어요.
runEvidence: README: 'uvx pyghidra-mcp ...', '-t, --transport [stdio|streamable-http|sse|http] ... [default: stdio]'; pyproject [project.scripts] pyghidra-mcp = pyghidra_mcp.server:main; PyPI 0.3.0.
concerns: Telemetry: only anonymized_telemetry=False for chromadb (already off). Beta. Dropped '--transport stdio' args since stdio is the default.
reason: Apache-2.0, recent commits, headless Ghidra option, uvx start with stdio default.
problems: Removed redundant '--transport stdio' (default is stdio per README help).
checked: Read LICENSE, pyproject scripts, README transport help and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR step, PyPI JSON, telemetry grep.

name: jadx
licenseQuote: Apache License, Version 2.0, January 2004 (LICENSE; no filled-in copyright line)
install: open the APK in jadx-gui so the plugin listens on port 8650
summaryEn: Lets an AI read a decompiled Android app that is open in JADX, class by class.
summaryKo: JADX에 열어 둔 안드로이드 앱을 AI가 클래스 단위로 읽어요.
capabilities: list classes and read decompiled source
comment or rename in the open project
guideEn: Two parts are needed: the jadx-ai-mcp plugin inside a running jadx-gui (port 8650) and this Python server, started with 'uv --directory <clone> run jadx_mcp_server.py' (stdio is the default; --http is optional). Open the APK in jadx-gui first, then call get_all_classes, get_android_manifest, search_classes_by_keyword, get_class_source and the xrefs_to_* tools. Use --jadx-host / --jadx-port if the plugin is elsewhere.
guideKo: 실행 중인 jadx-gui 안의 jadx-ai-mcp 플러그인(포트 8650)과 이 파이썬 서버가 둘 다 필요해요. 서버는 'uv --directory <클론 폴더> run jadx_mcp_server.py'로 띄우고 stdio가 기본이에요(--http는 선택). 먼저 jadx-gui에서 APK를 열고 get_all_classes, get_android_manifest, search_classes_by_keyword, get_class_source, xrefs_to_*를 써요.
warningsEn: jadx-gui with the plugin must be running with the APK open.
Needs Java 11+ and Python 3.10+ with uv.
No uvx/npx one-liner: the repo must be cloned and its path put in the command.
Do not bind the HTTP mode to 0.0.0.0 without a firewall; the README warns about it.
warningsKo: 플러그인을 설치한 jadx-gui를 켜고 APK를 열어 둬야 해요.
Java 11 이상과 uv가 있는 Python 3.10 이상이 필요해요.
uvx/npx 한 줄 실행이 없어서 저장소를 받아 그 경로를 명령에 넣어야 해요.
HTTP 모드를 방화벽 없이 0.0.0.0으로 열지 마세요(README도 경고해요).
runEvidence: README: 'jadx plugins --install "github:zinja-coder:jadx-ai-mcp"', 'uv run jadx_mcp_server.py --http', '--http | off | Use HTTP transport instead of stdio'; source main() calls mcp.run(show_banner=False) for stdio; pyproject [project.scripts] jadx_mcp_server.
concerns: Telemetry grep nothing in both repos. Companion plugin repo jadx-ai-mcp is Apache-2.0 (commit 9f4fce6f49902e95c62479c02d985d1eb0b3cbe1, 2026-10-19). PyPI 'jadx-mcp-server' 0.0.1 is unrelated; do not use. The 'uv --directory' stdio command is derived (README shows only --http; the sibling apktool README shows the --directory form) but stdio default is confirmed in source.
reason: Best-known jadx MCP, Apache-2.0, recent commits; setup cost is the clone plus plugin.
problems: Plugin install command confirmed at README line 383 (proposer had not read it).
Placeholder path changed from angle brackets to {path ...} style.
checked: Read both LICENSE files, README plugin install and options, pyproject scripts, main() stdio branch, telemetry grep, PyPI name mismatch.

name: apktool
licenseQuote: Apache License, Version 2.0, January 2004 (LICENSE; no filled-in copyright line)
install: install Apktool and Java so 'apktool' is on PATH
summaryEn: Decodes an APK with Apktool so an AI can read smali, resources and the manifest.
summaryKo: APK를 Apktool로 풀어 smali, 리소스, 매니페스트를 읽어요.
capabilities: decode an APK into a project folder
list and read smali files and resources
guideEn: Call decode_apk first, then get_manifest, the smali and resource listing tools and search_in_file to read the app. The modify_* tools, build_apk and clean_project change the decoded project and build a new APK, so use them only on apps you may modify. Start with 'uv --directory <clone> run apktool_mcp_server.py'.
guideKo: 먼저 decode_apk를 부른 뒤 get_manifest, smali와 리소스 목록 도구, search_in_file로 읽어요. modify_*, build_apk, clean_project는 풀어 둔 프로젝트를 바꾸고 새 APK를 만들어요. 'uv --directory <클론 폴더> run apktool_mcp_server.py'로 시작해요.
warningsEn: Needs Apktool and Java installed and on PATH.
Clone and path required; no uvx one-liner.
It can edit smali and rebuild an APK: use only on apps you own or may modify.
README says it was tested on Claude Desktop only.
warningsKo: Apktool과 Java가 설치되어 PATH에 있어야 해요.
저장소를 받아 경로를 넣어야 해요(uvx 한 줄 실행 없음).
smali를 고치고 APK를 다시 만들 수 있으니 직접 만들었거나 수정이 허용된 앱에만 쓰세요.
README에 Claude Desktop에서만 시험했다고 적혀 있어요.
runEvidence: README Claude Desktop setup: command uv, args --directory .../apktool-mcp-server/ run apktool_mcp_server.py; tools decode_apk, get_manifest listed; 'Tested on Claude Desktop Client'.
concerns: Telemetry grep found nothing. No [project.scripts] in pyproject. Last commit July 2026 (about 4.5 months). Repackaging capability is dual use. PyPI apktool-mcp-server has no license metadata and was not matched to this repo.
reason: Passes the rules but is small, tested on one client, clone-only, and offers repackaging; JADX covers most reading needs.
problems: Proposer recommended it; downgraded to recommend=false.
pyproject has no [project.scripts]; start relies on the script path as in the README.
checked: Read LICENSE, README setup/tools/tested lines, pyproject, telemetry grep, ls-remote.

name: wireshark
install: install Wireshark so the 'tshark' command is on PATH
summaryEn: Analyzes packet captures (pcap/pcapng) through tshark with 54 tools and anomaly detectors.
summaryKo: pcap 파일을 tshark로 분석해 통계와 이상 징후를 찾아요.
capabilities: open a capture and run a quick analysis
aggregate and extract fields across a capture
optional DuckDB index for large captures
guideEn: Start with wireshark_open_file, then wireshark_quick_analysis; use wireshark_aggregate for capture-wide counts and wireshark_get_packet_details to verify a conclusion. For big captures build the index with wireshark_index (needs the 'wireshark-mcp[index]' extra). 41 tools are read-only; 12 create files (live capture, merge, filter-save, editcap, text2pcap, frame extract, object export, case files).
guideKo: wireshark_open_file로 시작해 wireshark_quick_analysis를 돌리고, 전체 통계는 wireshark_aggregate로 봐요. 결론은 wireshark_get_packet_details로 확인해요. 큰 파일은 wireshark_index로 색인을 만들어요(wireshark-mcp[index] 추가 패키지 필요). 읽기 전용 도구가 41개이고 파일을 만드는 도구가 12개예요.
warningsEn: Needs Wireshark's tshark installed and on PATH.
Live capture needs capture rights; capture only on networks you may monitor.
12 tools create files.
warningsKo: Wireshark의 tshark가 설치되어 PATH에 있어야 해요.
실시간 캡처는 권한이 필요하고, 감시가 허용된 네트워크에서만 쓰세요.
파일을 만드는 도구가 12개 있어요.
runEvidence: README: 'pip install wireshark-mcp', 'Prerequisites: uv and Wireshark CLI (tshark)', plugin runs the project through uv over stdio; pyproject [project.scripts] wireshark-mcp = wireshark_mcp.server:main, license MIT; PyPI 4.0.0 with project URLs pointing to this repo.
concerns: Telemetry grep: no analytics code (only detector text about telemetry traffic). 'uvx wireshark-mcp' is derived from the script name, not a README line. Default transport stdio per proposer; not re-verified in server.py.
reason: MIT, recent commits, PyPI script entry, strong packet analysis server.
problems: Tool counts corrected from README: 41 read-only, 12 file-creating (not 'read-mostly').
uvx form is derived rather than quoted.
checked: Read LICENSE, pyproject (license, scripts), README prerequisites/tool counts, PyPI project URLs, telemetry grep.

name: x64dbg
install: download x64dbg_mcp.dp64 / .dp32 from https://github.com/bromoket/x64dbg_mcp/releases/latest into x64dbg's x64/plugins and x32/plugins folders
start x64dbg: the log shows '[MCP] x64dbg MCP Server started on 127.0.0.1:27042'
summaryEn: Controls the x64dbg debugger on Windows: run, step, breakpoints, memory, disassembly and tracing.
summaryKo: Windows의 x64dbg 디버거를 AI가 조작해 실행, 중단점, 메모리를 살펴봐요.
capabilities: run, step and pause the debuggee
guideEn: Put the plugin DLL into x64dbg's plugins folder, start x64dbg and open the target; the plugin listens on 127.0.0.1:27042 and the npx server talks to it. Tools are action-based (control, CPU and memory, stack, code analysis, breakpoints and tracing, symbols, process info, patching and dumping); see docs/REFERENCE.md in the repo. The plugin ships an optional auth token.
guideKo: 플러그인 DLL을 x64dbg plugins 폴더에 넣고 x64dbg를 켜서 대상을 열어요. 플러그인이 127.0.0.1:27042에서 기다리고 npx 서버가 거기에 연결해요. 도구는 제어, 메모리, 스택, 코드 분석, 중단점, 심볼, 프로세스, 패치로 나뉘어요. 자세한 내용은 저장소 docs/REFERENCE.md에 있어요. 인증 토큰은 선택이에요.
warningsEn: Windows only; x64dbg must be running with the plugin installed and a target open.
It runs and patches the debuggee: open only samples you trust to run in a safe environment.
Includes an anti-debug hide feature, meant for analysing protected samples.
warningsKo: Windows 전용이고, 플러그인을 넣은 x64dbg가 켜져 있고 대상이 열려 있어야 해요.
디버기를 실행하고 패치하므로 안전한 환경에서 믿을 만한 샘플만 여세요.
보호된 샘플 분석용 안티디버그 숨김 기능이 있어요.
runEvidence: README: '{ "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "x64dbg-mcp-server"] }'; 'localhost — no remote access, no telemetry'; npm x64dbg-mcp-server 2.3.0 MIT bin {x64dbg-mcp-server}.
concerns: README mentions anti-cheat scanner analysis and anti-debug bypass; it is a debugger, dual use. Plugin DLL comes from the repo's GitHub releases (binary, not inspected here). Telemetry: README states none; grep in src found nothing. x64dbg itself is separate (GPL), installed by the user. Proposer's '23 tools' count not re-verified; removed.
reason: MIT, 5 months since last commit but npx start works, documented no-telemetry, debugger fits the reverse-engineering set.
problems: Plugin DLL is a prebuilt binary the user downloads; flagged.
checked: Read LICENSE, README install/npx/telemetry/anti-debug lines, npm registry bin/license, telemetry grep.

name: osv-advisory
summaryEn: Looks up known vulnerabilities for package versions, Package URLs or commits in the free OSV.dev database.
summaryKo: OSV.dev에서 패키지 버전이나 커밋의 알려진 취약점을 찾아봐요.
capabilities: query one package version or PURL
audit many packages in one batch call
fetch a full advisory by ID
guideEn: Use osv_query_package with name, ecosystem and an exact version (or a PURL); osv_query_batch audits many packages at once; osv_get_vulnerability fetches the full record for an ID; osv_list_ecosystems gives valid ecosystem names. Versions must be exact, not ranges. No API key is needed.
guideKo: osv_query_package에 이름, 생태계, 정확한 버전(또는 PURL)을 주고, 많은 패키지는 osv_query_batch로 한꺼번에 점검해요. osv_get_vulnerability로 ID의 전체 정보를 보고 osv_list_ecosystems로 올바른 생태계 이름을 확인해요. 버전은 범위가 아니라 정확한 값이에요. API 키는 필요 없어요.
warningsEn: Needs Node 24 or newer (npm engines).
Sends package names and versions to the public OSV.dev API, so it needs internet.
An empty result means no known vulnerabilities, not that the package is safe.
warningsKo: Node 24 이상이 필요해요(npm engines).
패키지 이름과 버전이 공개 OSV.dev API로 전송되므로 인터넷이 필요해요.
결과가 비어 있어도 안전하다는 뜻이 아니라 알려진 취약점이 없다는 뜻이에요.
runEvidence: README: 'claude mcp add osv-advisory-mcp-server -- npx -y @cyanheads/osv-advisory-mcp-server', 'No API key is required'; env table MCP_TRANSPORT_TYPE default stdio, OTEL_ENABLED default false; npm 0.5.1 Apache-2.0 bin {osv-advisory-mcp-server} engines node >=24.
concerns: OpenTelemetry is optional and off by default (OTEL_ENABLED=false set in env). Tool names osv_* not re-listed from source in this pass (taken from README).
reason: Apache-2.0, npx start, keyless, committed yesterday.
problems: npm engines requires Node >=24; proposer's warning only implied it. Added.
checked: Read LICENSE, README install/env table, npm registry bin/engines, telemetry grep.

name: osv-scanner
summaryEn: Scans a project's lockfiles and dependencies against the OSV database for known vulnerabilities.
summaryKo: 프로젝트의 의존성을 OSV 데이터베이스와 대조해 알려진 취약점을 찾아요.
guideEn: Run 'osv-scanner scan source -r /path/to/dir' to scan a project recursively. Use '--offline --download-offline-databases' to avoid sending data to the network. Alternatives to go install: 'brew install osv-scanner' or a release binary (docs/installation.md).
guideKo: 'osv-scanner scan source -r <폴더>'로 프로젝트를 재귀 스캔해요. 네트워크로 보내고 싶지 않으면 '--offline --download-offline-databases'를 써요. go install 대신 'brew install osv-scanner'나 릴리스 바이너리로도 설치할 수 있어요(docs/installation.md).
warningsEn: By default it sends package names, versions, ecosystems and file hashes to the OSV API; use --offline to avoid that.
go.mod asks for Go 1.27.3, so go install needs a very recent Go; brew or a release binary is easier.
warningsKo: 기본으로 패키지 이름, 버전, 생태계, 파일 해시를 OSV API로 보내요. 막으려면 --offline을 쓰세요.
go.mod가 Go 1.27.3을 요구해서 go install에는 아주 최신 Go가 필요해요. brew나 릴리스 바이너리가 더 쉬워요.
runEvidence: README: 'go install github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@latest', '$ osv-scanner scan source -r /path/to/your/dir', 'osv-scanner --offline --download-offline-databases ./path/to/your/dir'; docs/installation.md: brew install osv-scanner.

name: gitleaks
summaryEn: Finds hard-coded secrets such as keys and tokens in git history and folders.
summaryKo: 깃 기록과 폴더에서 코드에 박힌 키와 토큰을 찾아요.
guideEn: 'gitleaks git -v' scans the git history of the current repo; 'gitleaks dir -v <path>' scans a folder or file. Add '--report-path report.json' to save findings and '--baseline-path' to ignore old ones. Install alternatives: docker run ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:latest, or a binary from the GitHub releases page.
guideKo: 'gitleaks git -v'는 현재 저장소의 깃 기록을, 'gitleaks dir -v <경로>'는 폴더나 파일을 검사해요. '--report-path report.json'으로 결과를 저장하고 '--baseline-path'로 이미 알려진 항목을 건너뛰어요. brew가 없으면 docker(ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:latest)나 릴리스 바이너리를 써요.
warningsEn: Findings can contain real secrets; treat the report file as sensitive and do not paste it into a chat.
The README documents brew, Docker and release binaries, not go install.
warningsKo: 결과에 실제 비밀 값이 들어 있을 수 있으니 보고서를 민감 정보로 다루고 채팅에 붙여넣지 마세요.
README는 brew, Docker, 릴리스 바이너리를 안내하고 go install은 안내하지 않아요.
runEvidence: README: 'gitleaks git -v', 'gitleaks dir -v path_to_directory_or_file', 'brew install gitleaks', docker run ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:latest, '--report-path', '--baseline-path'.

reason: MIT, maintained, the standard secret scanner.
